name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Remembering the 4 U.S. service members killed recently in the Iran war
changes.summary: A dignified transfer was held Wednesday for the four U.S. Army soldiers killed in the Middle East in recent days amid the ongoing war with Iran. Lindsey Reiser shares more details on Lt. Tyler James Feehan, Pvt. Isabella Gonzales, Sgt. Angel Rampersad and Sgt. Michael Emmanuel Swinton.

changes.title: House Passes Defense Bill Amid Iran War Divide
changes.summary: Republicans pushed through the $1.15 trillion bill over opposition from Democrats, who said backing it was akin to embracing the war.

changes.title: Houthis claim strikes on two Saudi tankers as US attacks on Iran widen
changes.summary: Attacks by Iranian-aligned Houthis in Red Sea follow Trump threats to destroy more Iranian infrastructure Yemen’s ⁠Houthi militia attacked two ​Saudi Arabian oil tankers, the Iranian-aligned group said on Thursday, with a Saudi news agency later confirming one of the vessels was ablaze in the Red Sea. changes.title: Iran’s Neighbors Long for a Deal, Any Deal, to End the War
changes.summary: Business owners in Pakistan are getting impatient for a chance to finally trade goods and oil along their long shared border with Iran.

changes.title: Send your questions for Richard Engel on the war with Iran and more
changes.summary: The United States is about to enter its fifth month of war with Iran, and NBC News’ chief foreign correspondent Richard Engel has been covering all the developments.

changes.title: See How Houthis Put the Red Sea at Risk as an Alternative Oil Route
changes.summary: Saudi Arabia has diverted huge amounts of oil to the Red Sea since the Iran war began, but now the Iranian-backed Houthi militants say that they intend to block that route.

changes.title: Speaking for Fallen Soldiers, Trump Says They Supported the Iran War
changes.summary: President Trump attended a dignified transfer for the soldiers as Americans were growing increasingly critical of the war.

changes.title: House Adopts $95 Billion G.O.P. Budget for Iran War
changes.summary: Republican leaders muscled through resistance in their own ranks to approve the budget blueprint for the war and other measures, but its prospects were far dimmer in the Senate.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Republicans passed more than $1 trillion for the Pentagon alongside a budget blueprint to fund the war with Iran and implement provisions of President Trump's election overhaul bill. (Image credit: Anna Moneymaker).

changes.title: Trump escalates threats, vows to target Iranian bridges and power plants
changes.summary: Iranian news agencies are reporting widespread aerial attacks across southern Iran. It comes as President Trump issued more threats against Iran and the Islamic Republic's foreign minister responded that any future attacks would be met with "an eye for an eye." White House correspondent Liz Landers reports.
